name: Dalen Yulewood
original_name: ダレン・ユールウッド
source:
[i]"Everyone acts according to what they believe is right, and all people shoulder some manner of sin."[/i]

[i]Drowning Ruler[/i]

The current head of House Yulewood and the heroine's uncle. He stands at the summit of the wealthiest family in the world. With no appearances in the media, he's completely disappeared from the public sphere. Though he's still only in his 40s, he looks like a withered old man. With a quiet and unexpressive demeanor, no one knows what he's truly thinking.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=dalen]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
